quotes.title: TOI-421
quotes.card: TOI-421 is a G-type main-sequence star located in the constellation Lepus.
quotes.introduction: The star hosts two transiting exoplanets discovered in 2020 and forms a visual binary system with a nearby red dwarf star BD−14 1137 B. Both planets are hot Neptunes well-suited for atmospheric characterization.
